_comment: Template validator config, generalized from semtech-landscape's own semtech_validation_config_vX.json. Fill in REPLACE_ME paths for a new byproduct. This config feeds the standard RDODI Stage 1-4 structural validator (rdodi_pipeline_validator or equivalent).
_note_on_R21: This validator is program 1 of the four-program R21 chain. It checks parse-level and stage-conformance correctness only; content-specific checks belong in the supplementary gates (program 2), and cross-stage properties belong in the procedure audit (program 3).
